answer: Operator Liability Ledger.** Each funded identity records the deposit account that paid its fees; liability follows that payer across every wallet they fund. When a gale of spam registrations appears, a challenge window lets reviewers trace shared funding to a single operator, and the ledger suspends that operator's entire set of identities plus forfeits a fixed deposit per confirmed sybil cluster. A legitimate actor may hold one mesa of registered wallets; a sybil farmer loses the whole vine at once.
